_comment: Mission 2, Scene 2: the warehouse (docs/script/mission2.md). 'arrive' plays as Mateo walks in; the walk-over trigger by the worker starts 'worker'. Speaker notes like (to the worker) are dropped, as Mission 1 did with (from the hallway). Wait events are staged by cutscenes/m2_warehouse.json (into_cold, phone_down, phone_up, sit, limes, case_out, push, door_held, take_case); set_clock moves the wall clock to the scripted times; {p:1500} holds the line as in Mission 1's waiting room.

arrive.text: A loading dock. Pallets of produce under plastic. A forklift beeps somewhere. A worker in a hairnet stands by a door marked with a snowflake.

cold_air.text: The door opens. Cold air. Crates of limes stacked to the ceiling. A man in a pressed shirt stands at a steel table with a phone at his ear. His back is half turned.

waits.text: The worker waits. The man doesn't turn.

listens.text: The man listens to the phone. He taps the table once.

face_down.text: He puts the phone face down. He still hasn't looked at Mateo.

window.speaker: MAN
window.text: Crossing window closes at eleven. Booth changes shift. Day officer doesn't care what's in a bag. The next one does.

drop.speaker: MAN
drop.text: Drop is behind Delgado Auto Parts, Fourth and Mesa. There's a patrol over the fence. It clears the yard around eleven-forty, a couple of minutes.

margin.speaker: MAN
margin.text: Late comes out of your margin.

lights_up.text: He picks the phone up again. It lights up. He reads it.

looks_at_clock.text: Mateo looks at the clock. 10:02. There's nowhere to sit but a crate.

options.text: I have to be through by eleven.

breath.text: Mateo sits on a crate. His breath shows. The man types with his thumb, then makes a call. A worker carries limes past them, twice.

ends_call.text: The man ends the call. He opens a cabinet and sets a gray hard-shell case on the table. Two small padlocks on the latches.

pushes.text: He pushes it across the table with two fingers.

holds.text: The worker holds the door open. Mateo takes the case. It's heavier than it looks.
